headline: MOL, Hitachi and JAL to trial Japan's first Direct Ocean Capture project off Kumejima
summary: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Hitachi and Japan Airlines signed an MoU to run Japan's first Direct Ocean Capture (DOC) demonstration on Kume Island, Okinawa — a land-based container unit that draws in seawater, strips out dissolved CO2 and discharges the treated water — and will explore using the recovered CO2 for synthetic aviation fuel (e-SAF). No capacity figure disclosed.
co2crc_note: Marine CDR / direct ocean capture is an emerging removal pathway adjacent to CO2CRC's storage focus; Japan's first DOC pilot and the Captura link are worth tracking for the APAC removals market.
extractor_note: MoU/pilot; no capacity or capital figure stated.

headline: Hungary's parliament abolishes its CO2 quota tax to ease EU ETS burden and unlock EU funds
summary: Hungarian lawmakers voted on 4 Aug to scrap the 2023 CO2 quota tax — a national levy on revenue from selling EU ETS free allowances — making prior payers eligible for refunds; the repeal follows the CJEU ruling in C-519/24 (16 Apr 2026) and is part of a package Hungary must pass by 31 Aug 2026 to access blocked EU funds.
organisations: Court of Justice of the European Union
co2crc_note: Indirect CCS relevance — repealing the levy restores the full value of the EU ETS carbon-price signal in Hungary, which underpins the economics of CCS and other abatement investment.
extractor_note: EU ETS carbon-pricing policy; CCS linkage is indirect (via carbon-price signal).

headline: Veolia trials the UK's first non-amine carbon capture at Sheffield energy-from-waste plant
summary: With cleantech firm C-Capture, Veolia is running a two-year pilot at Sheffield's Energy Recovery Facility using a non-amine solvent originally discovered at the University of Leeds, capturing up to 1 tonne of CO2 a day; non-amine solvents promise lower regeneration energy and avoid toxic amine-degradation products.
co2crc_note: Non-amine solvent capture on energy-from-waste flue gas is directly relevant to CO2CRC's capture-technology interests; watch for scale-up beyond the 1 tpd pilot.
extractor_note: Radar item — published 3 Aug, one day outside the window. capacity_mtpa is 1 t/day expressed in Mtpa (~0.000365).

headline: JERA and Taiwan Power Company sign a low-carbon energy MoU covering CCUS
summary: Japan's JERA and Taipower agreed a framework MoU to exchange knowledge on low-carbon fuel value chains, low-carbon power generation and CCUS; no capital figure was disclosed.
co2crc_note: Multinational-strategy signal for CCUS cooperation across North-East Asia; frames potential regional CCS demand.
extractor_note: Radar item — dated 30 Jul, outside the window; framework MoU with no capital figure.

headline: Sinopec's Qilu-Shengli CCUS project passes 2.4 Mt cumulative CO2
summary: China's first full-chain megatonne CCUS project has cumulatively captured and stored more than 2.4 Mt CO2, with Shengli Oilfield demo-area daily oil output lifted from 220 t to 506 t and EOR recovery-rate gains reported above 15%.
co2crc_note: Benchmark for a full-chain onshore CCUS-EOR operation at megatonne scale; cumulative-milestone context from China's flagship project.
extractor_note: Radar item — cumulative-milestone re-report dated 29 Jul, outside the window. capacity_mtpa reflects the project's ~1 Mtpa nameplate, not the 2.4 Mt cumulative figure.
